metadata.source: UN map No. 103.1(b), Feb 1956 reprint of A/516 Annex A map (Plan of Partition with Economic Union, GA res. 181 (II), 29 Nov 1947); Wikimedia Commons, PD-UN-map
metadata.method: Colour segmentation of the 1370x2838 raster, gaps assigned to nearest zone, georeferenced by affine fit to 8 graticule intersections (30-33N x 35-36E), max residual 0.37 km; simplified 0.0006 deg (~60 m). Pixel ~160 m. Coastline/lake edges follow the 1946 base map, not Natural Earth.
metadata.accuracy: Approximate: ~0.3-0.5 km typical, up to ~1 km along thin boundary lines; suitable for broadcast graphics, not for legal or survey use.
